ayahOccurrences.text: وَخُذْ بِيَدِكَ ضِغْثًا فَٱضْرِب بِّهِۦ وَلَا تَحْنَثْ ۗ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَٰهُ صَابِرًا ۚ نِّعْمَ ٱلْعَبْدُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: وَخُذْ بِيَدِكَ ضِغْثًا فَٱضْرِب بِّهِۦ وَلَا تَحْنَثْ ۗ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَٰهُ صَابِرًا ۚ نِّعْمَ ٱلْعَبْدُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ

lexSnapshot.wordGrammar: 2nd person masculine singular imperfect verb, jussive mood
lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: تَحْنَثْ is in the derivative form: تَحْنَثُ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ح/ن/ث   ḥ–n–th manhood, maturity; sin, blasphemy, denial of God, wickedness; breaking an oath, perjury; to purify oneself, to worship, responsibility.

Of this root, 2 forms occur 1 time each in the Qur’an:
تَحْنَثُ taḥnath and حِنْث ḥinth.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
تَحْنَثُ taḥnath [imperf. of v. حَنِثَ ḥanitha, intrans. with prep. فى] to break one’s oath, to fail to honour one’s oath

(38:44) وَخُذْ بِيَدِكَ ضِغْثًا فَاضْرِبْ بِهِ وَلاَ تَحْنَثْ and take in your hand a small bunch of grass, and strike with it, so as not to break your oath.

entries.label: حِنْث
entries.definitionHtml:
حِنْث ḥinth [v. n.; n.] abomination, sinning, breaking one’s oath, denial of God

(56:46) وَكَانُوا يُصِرُّونَ عَلَى الْحِنْثِ الْعَظِيمِ and they always persisted in great sin.
